name: Jash Engineering Ltd
title: Jash Engineering Ltd - 544402 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR757 crore (vs 746) as US tariff-driven production slowdown and Middle East shipping disruption hit exports; FY27 guided to INR875 crore with 12-13% PAT, backed by INR899 crore order book.

capex.quote: the five Indian plants, around INR15-16 crore is the capex planning

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR875 crore
triggers.quote: looking to that out of INR940-950 crores to project INR875 crore for the current year revenue

triggers.label: Q4 GM lift from FX, not price
triggers.quote: Forex improvement leads to better pricing. Suppose I had taken a USD10,000 job six months back

triggers.label: US order intake restarted
triggers.quote: from October, November, December, we had started taking orders also in America

triggers.label: Houston plant cost up, timing slipping
triggers.quote: the cost has gone up tremendously

guidance.quote: to project INR875 crore for the current year revenue
our profit guidance would be the range of 12-13%
double the revenue from INR757 crore to upwards of INR1500 crores
the five Indian plants, around INR15-16 crore is the capex planning

guidance.metric: Rodney Hunt Houston and Saudi plants commissioning
guidance.quote: the target is now to have it commissioned before December 2027

red_flags.label: Order book growth not matching execution
red_flags.quote: The order book is close to USD38-39 million

red_flags.label: Earnings sensitive to FX gains
red_flags.quote: one of the reasons, as I said, was also that we could improve our gross margin because of high gain in foreign currency

red_flags.label: Opaque working capital and merged-entity data
red_flags.quote: we will talk to EY. If it is an industry standard will do it.

red_flags.label: Q4 other expenses spike from bank charge
red_flags.quote: It is a bank charge from the US.

evasions.quote: Because it is merged , it will be difficult for me to tell like this

evasions.topic: Volume vs value split of gains
evasions.quote: Can you please put this on an email to us.
We will talk to EY. If it is an industry standard will do it.
I am not sure I will get all the USD800-900 million orders.
